param: β Transmission rate parameter (per-contact transmission scaled by contact rate). Used in force of infection λ(t) which is proportional to β and the number of infectious individuals.
λ(t) Force of infection (rate at which a susceptible becomes infected). Assumed proportional to the number of infectious people at time t and transmission rate β (homogeneous mixing).
σ Daily progression rate through latent (exposed) stages: E₁→E₂ and E₂→I₁. Implies mean incubation period d_L = 2*(1/σ) days.
γ Daily progression/recovery rate through infectious stages: I₁→I₂ and I₂→R. Implies mean infectious period d_I = 2*(1/γ) days.
δt Discrete time step used in the difference-equation form of the compartmental model.
